title: Parking in disabled spots
question: Can I park in a disabled parking spot without a permit?
short_answer: No. Disabled spots are strictly reserved for people with valid disability cards.
conditions: Only vehicles displaying a valid disability parking card (karta parkingowa) may use these spots
The card must be clearly visible on the dashboard
Foreign EU disability cards are also valid in Poland
exceptions: Emergency service vehicles during active operations
penalties: Fine: 800 PLN for parking in a disabled spot without a valid card

sources.title: Prawo o ruchu drogowym – Sejm RP
